summary: Runs your shell scripts when the IDE opens a project, saves a file, or finishes a build.
description: Hooks Code on the Go into the workflows you already script. Put an executable script in a hooks folder and it runs when a project opens or closes, a file is opened, saved or closed, or a build starts, succeeds or fails, with the file or project passed in $1. Scripts kept in a project run only after you review and trust them. Off until you turn it on.
